summary.plain: The group of institutions that built and ran the Whipple 10 m telescope in Arizona, where in 1989 the imaging Cherenkov technique first detected a TeV gamma-ray source, the Crab Nebula.
summary.technical: Whipple Collaboration, formally constituted in 1982 (Hawaii, Iowa State, SAO, University College Dublin, Durham); pioneered the imaging atmospheric Cherenkov technique with the Whipple 10 m telescope; predecessor of the VERITAS collaboration.
